rationale: The short thesis is intact and only two minutes old: price is still below both VWAP ($13.60) and the 9-EMA ($13.57) on 18.8x relative volume, the tape remains risk-off (SPY -0.67%, VIXY +2.11%), and 14 cents of room to the prior close stands against a defined ~6-cent stop (~$31 risk). The heavy-volume pin at $13.56 shows a real defender at the lows, but the $13.62 stop caps that scenario cheaply, and flipping long would fight a failed-gap bleed while paying two spreads for a weaker setup.
